content: {"episode_id":"ep-05038","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for episode ep-05038, billed with diagnosis codes G45.9, I25.10, and I49.5. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease. Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control. We request reconsideration of the precertification denial based on this documented medical necessity."}
